user.title: Connect your DigitalPlat account
user.description: Create an API key at [DigitalPlat → API Keys]({api_keys_url}) and paste it here. It starts with `dp_live_` and is shown only once.

data_description.api_key: Stored only in your Home Assistant. Used to read your domains and, when you press Renew, to renew them.

domains.title: Choose your domains
domains.description: Select the domains Home Assistant should track.

data_description.window_days: Days before expiration when free renewal opens (DigitalPlat currently shows 120).

reauth_confirm.title: API key no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new key at [DigitalPlat → API Keys]({api_keys_url}) for the same account.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Replace the key with another one from the same DigitalPlat account ([API Keys]({api_keys_url})).
